aag_astral-drifter: A wanderer who spent time adrift in the Astral Sea, returning with a touch of magic and spiritual curiosity.
aag_astral-elf: Elves tied to the Astral Plane, with a free light-themed cantrip, a teleporting step, sleep resistance, and a trance-like rest.
aag_autognome: Small constructs with built-in armor, a once-per-use d4 boost to rolls, healing from repair, and immunity to many biological ailments.
aag_giff: Hippo-headed soldiers who add force damage to weapon hits, excel at firearms and explosives, and can swim as fast as they walk.
aag_hadozee: Simian gliders that can slow a fall with skin membranes, climb at full speed, and use their feet to handle objects.
aag_plasmoid: Ooze folk that squeeze through tiny gaps, reshape limbs, resist acid and poison, hold their breath long, and see in the dark.
aag_thri-kreen: Insectoid nomads with a color-shifting carapace, extra arms, telepathy, sleepless rest, and darkvision.
aag_wildspacer: A hardy traveler raised among spelljamming crews, comfortable with the dangers of the void between worlds.
ai_celebrity-adventurers-scion: The child of a famous adventurer, used to fame, public scrutiny and the doors that a well-known surname opens.
ai_failed-merchant: A once-ambitious trader whose business collapsed, leaving old contacts and hard lessons in commerce to lean on.
ai_gambler: A risk-loving card sharp or dice player who knows how to read opponents and thrives on a wager.
ai_plaintiff: Someone who spent years entangled in lawsuits and can bluster with legal jargon to rattle those who fear the courts.
ai_rival-intern: A former apprentice at a competing firm who still has informants there and inside knowledge of how rivals operate.
ai_verdan: Plant-touched folk who can alter their size, gain a bonus to Persuasion, and learn a few druidic cantrips through a mystic bond.
au_abjuration-adept: Keeps abjuration spells always prepared and grants temporary hit points to you or a nearby ally when you cast them.
au_agent-of-the-ninth-quill: A covert operative of a secretive scholarly order, trained to slip past guarded places using arcane tricks.
au_arcane-artist: Teaches the Minor Illusion cantrip and lets illusion spells hand an ally Heroic Inspiration once per long rest.
au_arcane-eloquence: Teaches the Vicious Mockery cantrip and adds a small die to Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion checks.
au_arcane-infiltrator: Teaches the Friends cantrip and lets you take the Dodge action as a bonus action a few times per long rest.
au_arcane-omens: Teaches the Guidance cantrip and lets you use a reaction to boost a failed saving throw for yourself or someone nearby.
au_arcane-overload: Teaches the Fire Bolt cantrip and lets you add your proficiency bonus to evocation damage once per long rest.
au_arcane-safeguard: Teaches the Resistance cantrip, castable as a bonus action, and gives allies temporary hit points when you help their ability checks.
au_arcane-undertaker: Teaches a necromancy cantrip, boosts History and Medicine checks, and earns Heroic Inspiration for stabilizing a dying creature.
au_arcane-warrior: Teaches two wizard cantrips to characters with a fighting style, and lets you swap one out whenever you level up.
au_bejeweled-conclave-spy: A glittering courtly informant who gathers secrets among the wealthy, gifted with magic that makes persuasion and eloquence easier.
au_boon-of-erupting-spellpower: Once per rest, a damaging spell treats low damage dice as higher results and knocks the creatures it damages prone.
au_boon-of-magic-school-mastery: Pick a school of magic to gain a free level 1 spell and a free higher-level signature spell; can be taken repeatedly.
au_boon-of-the-iron-mind: Makes your concentration very hard to break, since only casting another concentration spell, certain conditions, or death will end it.
au_conjuration-adept: Keeps a set of conjuration spells always prepared and adds a bonus to concentration saves while sustaining conjuration spells.
au_cosmic-dawn-experiment: A living product of strange arcane tinkering, whose body was reshaped through transmutation and who now wanders in the wild.
au_covenant-of-the-grave-recruit: A caretaker of the dead trained in burial rites and undead lore, with a magical undertaker's craft.
au_crucible-storm-chaser: A daredevil who chases raw magical storms and has learned to channel their surging energy, at some risk.
au_divination-adept: Keeps divination spells always prepared and lets you use a reaction to give a creature advantage or disadvantage on a d20 roll.
au_elemental-familiar: Infuses your familiar with an element, giving it damage resistance and a reaction burst that damages and knocks down nearby foes.
au_enchantment-adept: Keeps enchantment spells always prepared and lets you cast enchantment spells without most spell components.
au_evocation-adept: Keeps evocation spells always prepared and lets you spend Hit Dice to add extra damage to an evocation spell once per turn.
au_familiar-friend: Gives you Find Familiar for free once per rest, a sturdier familiar, and advantage on skill checks when it is beside you.
au_familiar-trainer: Someone raised to bond with and train magical companions, now accompanied by a clever familiar.
au_horizon-weaver-initiate: A nomadic craftsperson who weaves fabric and magic together, trained to hop between places through shimmering portals.
au_illusion-adept: Keeps illusion spells always prepared, lets you cast them without most components, and makes your illusions harder to see through.
au_magic-connoisseur: Adds a free level 1 and level 2 spell from your Magic Initiate list, swappable as you level.
au_necromancy-adept: Keeps necromancy spells always prepared and lets you spend Hit Dice to heal yourself when casting a necromancy spell.
au_otherworldly-familiar: Empowers your familiar with resistance to a chosen otherworldly damage type and the ability to pass through creatures and objects.
au_phantasmic-circus-trouper: A traveling performer from a magical circus, skilled at dazzling crowds with illusions and artful trickery.
au_portal-jumper: Grants resistance to one otherworldly damage type and lets you spend movement to teleport a short distance a few times per day.
au_seer-apprentice: A student of fortune-telling who learned to read signs and portents, gaining a knack for arcane omens.
au_soothing-familiar: Your familiar radiates healing energy that lets allies near it treat low healing dice rolls as higher results.
au_spell-resistant: Grants resistance to a chosen damage type and lets you add a die to saving throws against spells and magical effects.
au_spell-subterfuge: After casting an action spell, you can Dash and Hide as a bonus action, and casting keeps you hidden more easily.
au_transmutation-adept: Keeps transmutation spells always prepared and gives you extra speed for the turn when you cast a transmutation spell.
au_transmuted-anatomy: Increases your speed, gives advantage against forced shape-shifting, and lets you boost failed Constitution saves a few times per day.
au_ward-of-the-sheltering-hands: An orphan or refugee raised by kind caretakers, who learned protective magic to keep others safe.
au_warlike-familiar: Gives you the Battle Familiar spell free once per rest and lets your familiar use a reaction to raise an ally's AC.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-acolyte: A former temple servant from Baldur's Gate who can find shelter and support among fellow believers.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-charlatan: A smooth-talking Baldur's Gate swindler who keeps a false identity ready and knows how to run a con.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-criminal: A career lawbreaker from Baldur's Gate with dependable underworld contacts who can pass along messages and favors.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-entertainer: A Baldur's Gate performer who can always earn a place to stay by playing for audiences.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-folk-hero: A commoner from Baldur's Gate who rose up against a local threat and is welcomed by ordinary people.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-guild-artisan: A Baldur's Gate craftsperson belonging to a trade guild, with membership that brings lodging, support and influence.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-hermit: A Baldur's Gate recluse who lived in isolation and emerged with a quiet, valuable discovery.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-noble: A Baldur's Gate aristocrat who enjoys status, deference from commoners and the comforts of family standing.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-outlander: A Baldur's Gate-area wilderness native who navigates the wilds and can reliably find food and water for a group.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-sage: A Baldur's Gate scholar who spent years in study and knows where to track down answers to obscure questions.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-sailor: A Baldur's Gate seafarer who can secure passage on ships for free thanks to a sailor's camaraderie.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-soldier: A Baldur's Gate veteran of military service who still commands a measure of respect from other soldiers.
bgdia_baldurs-gate-urchin: A Baldur's Gate street kid who survived on wits alone and knows secret ways to dash across the city.
bgdia_faceless: Someone who abandoned an old identity to serve a shadowy organization, hiding behind a new face and name.
bgg_ember-of-the-fire-giant: Grants fire resistance and lets you replace an attack with a fiery burst that damages and blinds nearby enemies.
bgg_fury-of-the-frost-giant: Grants cold resistance and a reaction that blasts an attacker with ice, damaging it and stopping its movement.
bgg_giant-foundling: A mortal child raised by giants, carrying the strength and stubborn spirit of a giant's upbringing.
bgg_guile-of-the-cloud-giant: Lets you use a reaction when hit to resist that attack's damage and teleport to a nearby space.
bgg_keenness-of-the-stone-giant: Grants darkvision and a bonus-action magical rock throw that deals force damage and can knock the target prone.
bgg_rune-carver: A craftsperson trained in giant runes, able to carve symbols that hold lasting magical power.
bgg_rune-shaper: Lets you inscribe runes onto objects to gain temporary spells, plus a free comprehend languages casting and changeable rune choices.
bgg_soul-of-the-storm-giant: Grants lightning and thunder resistance and a bonus-action storm aura that imposes disadvantage on attacks against you and slows enemies.
bgg_strike-of-the-giants: Choose a giant's power to add an extra damage and effect to a weapon hit, usable several times per long rest.
bgg_vigor-of-the-hill-giant: Lets you use a reaction to avoid being moved or knocked prone, and boosts healing when you eat during a short rest.
bmt_cartomancer: Lets you use a card deck as a spell focus, learn Prestidigitation, and imbue a card with a spell to cast later.
bmt_rewarded: Someone who received an unexpected windfall of good fortune, which brought a minor magical boon.
bmt_ruined: A person who lost everything through misfortune but retained hidden resilience that surprises others.
dmg_aarakocra: Bird people with a flying speed, a bonus-damage dive attack, and sharp talons for unarmed strikes.
dmg_aasimar: Celestial-touched folk with darkvision, necrotic and radiant resistance, a healing touch, and a light cantrip.
dmg_bullywug: Frog-like swamp dwellers that breathe both air and water, hide well in swamps, leap far, and speak with frogs.
dmg_elf-eladrin: Fey elf variant with weapon training and a once-per-rest short teleport.
dmg_gnoll: Hyena-headed fighters with a fanged bite for unarmed strikes, a rampaging bonus attack, and darkvision.
dmg_gnome-deep: Underdark gnomes with superior darkvision, a few innate illusion spells, and stealth bonuses among rock.
dmg_goblin: Small, nimble folk who can disengage or hide as a bonus action each turn, plus darkvision.
dmg_grimlock: Blind cave dwellers that sense surroundings without sight, hear and smell keenly, and hide well among stone.
dmg_hobgoblin: Disciplined warriors that deal extra damage next to allies, with darkvision and a gift for saving face against failure.
dmg_kenku: Crow-like mimics that ambush surprised enemies, imitate any sound heard, and see in the dark.
dmg_kobold: Small dragon-kin with pack tactics, darkvision, and a weakness in bright sunlight.
dmg_kuo-toa: Fish-like beings that breathe water, sense invisible creatures, slip free of grapples, and suffer in sunlight.
dmg_lizardfolk: Scaled reptilian folk with natural armor, a long breath hold, and a swimming speed.
dmg_merfolk: Aquatic folk who breathe air and water and swim quickly but move slowly on land.
dmg_orc: Fierce warriors with darkvision and a bonus-action rush toward enemies.
dmg_skeleton: Undead characters immune to poison and exhaustion, needing no sleep or air, but vulnerable to bludgeoning damage.
dmg_troglodyte: Reptilian cave dwellers that blend into surroundings, emit a poisonous stench, and see in the dark.
dmg_zombie: Undead characters that can refuse to fall when reduced to zero hit points, resist poison, and need no sleep or air.
dsotdq_adept-of-the-black-robes: Gives a free level 2 enchantment or necromancy spell and lets you spend Hit Dice to increase damage your spells deal.
dsotdq_adept-of-the-red-robes: Gives a free level 2 illusion or transmutation spell and lets you treat low d20 rolls as a 10.
dsotdq_adept-of-the-white-robes: Gives a free level 2 abjuration or divination spell and lets you spend a spell slot to reduce damage to others.
dsotdq_divinely-favored: Teaches a cleric cantrip, an alignment-based level 1 spell, and augury, with free casts and a holy symbol usable as a focus.
dsotdq_initiate-of-high-sorcery: Teaches a wizard cantrip and two level 1 spells tied to a chosen moon, each castable once for free per long rest.
dsotdq_kender: Small, fearless folk who resist fright, gain a mischievous curiosity ability to poke at things, and taunt foes into losing composure.
dsotdq_knight-of-solamnia: A squire or knight in the honor-bound Solamnic order, trained to uphold its code in battle.
dsotdq_knight-of-the-crown: Lets you use a bonus action to command an ally to make a weapon attack with bonus damage.
dsotdq_knight-of-the-rose: Lets you use a bonus action to give yourself or a nearby creature temporary hit points.
dsotdq_knight-of-the-sword: Lets you frighten a creature you hit with a weapon, or else hinder its next attack, a few times per rest.
dsotdq_mage-of-high-sorcery: A magic user trained in the Towers of High Sorcery, schooled in arcane tradition and its political tensions.
dsotdq_squire-of-solamnia: Makes mounting cheap and lets you gain advantage on a weapon attack and add bonus damage if it hits.
efa_aberrant-dragonmark: Grants a sorcerer cantrip and free level 1 spell, a boost to failed Constitution saves, and a risky Hit Die surge.
efa_aberrant-heir: A person bearing a strange, unruly dragonmark, whose power is feared and misunderstood by others.
efa_archaeologist: A relic hunter who explores ancient ruins and maps forgotten places, picking up a wide set of useful skills.
efa_boon-of-siberys: Gives you a free, componentless high-level sorcerer or dragonmark spell that you can cast once per rest.
efa_changeling: Fey shapechangers who alter their appearance and voice at will and gain proficiency in social skills.
efa_greater-aberrant-mark: Improves your Aberrant Dragonmark's save boost and recovery, and lets cantrips convert Hit Dice into temporary hit points and force damage.
efa_greater-mark-of-detection: Improves the Mark of Detection's check bonus die and lets you share its See Invisibility effect with a nearby creature.
efa_greater-mark-of-finding: Improves the Mark of Finding's check bonus die and gives your Hunter's Mark double range and the ability to reveal invisible targets.
efa_greater-mark-of-handling: Improves the Mark of Handling's check bonus die, lets your mount act after your hit, and lets you frighten beasts and monstrosities.
efa_greater-mark-of-healing: Improves the Mark of Healing's check bonus die, adds free Cure Wounds casts, and raises low healing dice results.
efa_greater-mark-of-hospitality: Improves the Mark of Hospitality's check die and lets Purify Food and Drink refresh allies with reduced exhaustion and temporary hit points.
efa_greater-mark-of-making: Improves the Mark of Making's check bonus die and makes your free Magic Weapon cast take effect at level 3 strength.
efa_greater-mark-of-passage: Improves the Mark of Passage's check bonus die and lets two allies also teleport when you use your free Misty Step.
efa_greater-mark-of-scribing: Improves the Mark of Scribing's check bonus die and lets Comprehend Languages cover three allies who can also speak telepathically.
efa_greater-mark-of-sentinel: Improves the Mark of Sentinel's check die and adds a free attack when you swap places to take a hit.
efa_greater-mark-of-shadow: Improves the Mark of Shadow's check bonus die and makes your free Invisibility cast work at level 3 strength.
efa_greater-mark-of-storm: Improves the Mark of Storm's check bonus die and gives you a flying speed while your free Gust of Wind lasts.
efa_greater-mark-of-warding: Improves the Mark of Warding check die and lets you use a reaction to impose disadvantage on attacks against allies.
efa_house-agent: A trusted operative working for a dragonmarked house, handling its delicate business with some luck on their side.
efa_house-cannith-heir: A scion of the artificing house, born to build and repair, and gifted with the Mark of Making.
efa_house-deneith-heir: A scion of the mercenary and guard house, raised to protect clients, and bearing the Mark of Sentinel.
efa_house-ghallanda-heir: A scion of the innkeeping house, raised among hospitality and good food, and carrying the Mark of Hospitality.
efa_house-jorasco-heir: A scion of the healer house, trained in medicine and herbs, and carrying the Mark of Healing.
efa_house-kundarak-heir: A scion of the banking and security house, raised around vaults and locks, with the Mark of Warding.
efa_house-lyrandar-heir: A scion of the seafaring and sky-shipping house, raised among storms, and bearing the Mark of Storm.
efa_house-medani-heir: A scion of the investigative house, trained to uncover secrets and sense danger, with the Mark of Detection.
efa_house-orien-heir: A scion of the transport house, raised amid roads and rails, with the Mark of Passage for swift travel.
efa_house-phiarlan-heir: A scion of the elven entertainer-spy house, trained in performance and intrigue, with the Mark of Shadow.
efa_house-sivis-heir: A scion of the scribe and messenger house, trained in language and records, with the Mark of Scribing.
efa_house-tharashk-heir: A scion of the tracker and bounty-hunter house, raised to find quarry, with the Mark of Finding.
efa_house-thuranni-heir: A scion of the elven house of performers and spies, skilled at stagecraft and stealth, with the Mark of Shadow.
efa_house-vadalis-heir: A scion of the animal-breeding house, raised with beasts and herbal lore, with the Mark of Handling.
efa_inquisitive: A sharp-eyed investigator who tracks down criminals and clues, ever alert to anything out of place.
efa_kalashtar: Psychic-bonded people with advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves, psychic resistance, and telepathy that grows with level.
efa_khoravar: Fey-touched people of mixed heritage with darkvision, charm resistance, and a swappable spell-list cantrip.
efa_mark-of-detection: Adds a die to Investigation and Insight checks and grants free detection spells, with See Invisibility joining at level 3.
efa_mark-of-finding: Adds a die to Perception and Survival checks and grants free Hunter's Mark, with Locate Object joining at level 3.
efa_mark-of-handling: Adds a die to Nature and Animal Handling checks and grants free animal-communication spells that can also affect some monstrosities.
efa_mark-of-healing: Adds a die to Medicine and herbalism checks and grants a free Cure Wounds, with Lesser Restoration joining at level 3.
efa_mark-of-hospitality: Adds a die to Persuasion and cooking or brewing checks and grants free innkeeper-themed spells, with Calm Emotions at level 3.
efa_mark-of-making: Adds a die to Arcana and artisan's tool checks, teaches Mending, and grants a free Magic Weapon spell.
efa_mark-of-passage: Increases your speed, adds a die to Athletics and Acrobatics checks, and grants a free Misty Step.
efa_mark-of-scribing: Adds a die to History and calligraphy checks, teaches Message, and grants free Comprehend Languages, with Magic Mouth at level 3.
efa_mark-of-sentinel: Adds a die to Insight and Perception checks, grants a free Shield spell, and lets you take hits for others.
efa_mark-of-shadow: Adds a die to Stealth and Performance checks, teaches Minor Illusion, and grants a free Invisibility spell.
efa_mark-of-storm: Adds a die to Acrobatics and navigation checks, grants lightning resistance and Thunderclap, and gives free Gust of Wind at level 3.
efa_mark-of-warding: Adds a die to Investigation and thieves' tools checks and grants free Alarm and Mage Armor, with Arcane Lock at level 3.
efa_potent-dragonmark: Keeps your dragonmark's spells always prepared and gives you an extra spell slot reserved for casting them.
efa_shifter: Beast-touched folk who shift into a bestial form for temporary hit points and a lineage-based combat perk.
efa_warforged: Living constructs with poison resistance, a built-in armor bonus, no need to sleep, and armor that resists being forcibly removed.
egw_augen-trust-spy: A covert informant working for a Dwendalian spy network, skilled at deception and gathering secrets.
egw_cobalt-scholar-sage: A researcher of the Cobalt Soul, a scholarly order, who has access to its libraries and knowledgeable colleagues.
egw_dragonborn-draconblood: Scholarly dragonborn with darkvision and a gift for turning conversations toward their favor.
egw_dragonborn-ravenite: Martial dragonborn with darkvision who can retaliate with a weapon attack when hurt by something in reach.
egw_elf-pallid: Moon-touched elves with sharp investigative senses, a light cantrip, and sleep and invisibility spells at higher levels.
egw_grinner: A member of a rowdy underground band of street-theater rebels who can find hideouts through music.
egw_halfling-lotusden: Forest halflings with druidcraft and nature spells that entangle and sprout spikes, plus a knack for plant lore.
egw_luxonborn-acolyte: A devotee of the Luxon, the radiant being worshiped in Wildemount, who finds welcome among its followers.
egw_myriad-operative-criminal: A criminal who works for a shadowy network of thieves and smugglers and can rely on its contacts.
egw_orc: Wildemount orcs with darkvision, aggressive movement, and powerful builds.
egw_revelry-pirate-sailor: A pirate who sailed with a band of freebooters, known and feared on the waters of Wildemount.
egw_volstrucker-agent: A secret assassin serving a notorious Dwendalian group, trained to kill quietly and to vanish.
erlw_aberrant-dragonmark: Grants a sorcerer cantrip and free level 1 spell, with an optional Hit Die surge, but saddles you with a random flaw.
erlw_bugbear: Long-limbed goblinoids with extended melee reach, stealth proficiency, a surprise-attack damage burst, and darkvision.
erlw_changeling: Shapechangers who copy appearances at will and gain two social skill proficiencies.
erlw_dwarf-mark-of-warding: Dragonmarked dwarves with a die bonus on investigation and thieves' tools checks, plus alarm, mage armor, and arcane lock.
erlw_elf-mark-of-shadow: Dragonmarked elves with a die bonus on Performance and Stealth, minor illusion, and a once-per-rest invisibility spell.
erlw_gnome-mark-of-scribing: Dragonmarked gnomes with bonuses on History and calligraphy checks, the message cantrip, and comprehend languages.
erlw_goblin: Eberron goblins using the standard goblin traits, with a different cultural outlook.
erlw_half-elf-variant-mark-of-detection: Dragonmarked half-elves with a die bonus on Investigation and Insight, plus detection and see invisibility magic.
erlw_half-elf-variant-mark-of-storm: Dragonmarked half-elves with lightning resistance, a die bonus on Acrobatics and navigation, and wind magic.
erlw_half-orc-variant-mark-of-finding: Dragonmarked half-orcs who track well, gain a die bonus on Perception and Survival, and cast hunting and tracking spells.
erlw_halfling-mark-of-healing: Dragonmarked halflings with a die bonus on Medicine checks and healing spells such as cure wounds and lesser restoration.
erlw_halfling-mark-of-hospitality: Dragonmarked halflings with a die bonus on Persuasion and cooking checks, plus food, comfort and servant magic.
erlw_hobgoblin: Eberron hobgoblins using the standard hobgoblin traits within a strict martial culture.
erlw_house-agent: A trusted operative of a dragonmarked house who can call on its agents and resources for help.
erlw_human-mark-of-handling: Dragonmarked humans with animal-focused skill bonuses and spells for befriending and speaking with beasts.
erlw_human-mark-of-making: Dragonmarked humans with Arcana and artisan bonuses, an extra tool proficiency, mending, and magic weapon.
erlw_human-mark-of-passage: Dragonmarked humans with extra walking speed, travel-skill bonuses, and a once-per-rest short teleport.
erlw_human-mark-of-sentinel: Dragonmarked humans with Insight and Perception bonuses, a protective shield spell, and a way to guard allies.
erlw_human-variant-mark-of-finding: Dragonmarked humans with darkvision, tracking bonuses, and spells for locating creatures and hunting prey.
erlw_kalashtar: Humans bonded with dream spirits who resist mental effects and psychic damage and share telepathy.
erlw_orc: Eberron orcs with darkvision, aggressive charges, and strong lifelong endurance.
erlw_revenant-blade: Gives a small armor class bonus when wielding a double-bladed scimitar in two hands, and makes that weapon finesse.
erlw_shifter: Beast-touched people with darkvision who shift briefly into a bestial form, with benefits depending on subrace.
erlw_shifter-beasthide: Shifter subrace gaining Athletics proficiency, extra temporary hit points when shifting, and a small AC boost while shifted.
erlw_shifter-longtooth: Shifter subrace gaining Intimidation proficiency and a fanged bonus-action bite while shifted.
erlw_shifter-swiftstride: Shifter subrace gaining Acrobatics proficiency, faster movement while shifted, and a free reactive step away from foes.
erlw_shifter-wildhunt: Shifter subrace gaining Survival proficiency, Wisdom check advantage while shifted, and protection from advantaged attackers.
erlw_warforged: Living constructs that need no food or sleep, resist poison and disease, and gain a bonus to armor class.
