frhof_boon-of-bountiful-health: Increases temporary hit points you gain and lets you take maximum results when spending Hit Dice to heal.
frhof_boon-of-communication: Removes the penalty for influencing hostile creatures, lets you understand any language, and gives you short-range telepathy.
frhof_boon-of-desperate-resilience: While you are Bloodied, you resist nearly every damage type.
frhof_boon-of-exquisite-radiance: Prevents creatures you kill from rising as undead and lets you maximize radiant damage dice once per long rest.
frhof_boon-of-fluid-forms: Lets you shape-shift into a creature of limited power once per long rest, with extra temporary hit points from the change.
frhof_boon-of-fortunes-favor: Lets you reroll a failed saving throw, though not again until the start of your next turn.
frhof_boon-of-poison-mastery: Makes you immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and lets you maximize poison damage dice once per turn.
frhof_boon-of-revelry: Grants a free, component-free Otto's Irresistible Dance that keeps concentration under fire and stops affected targets from casting verbal spells.
frhof_boon-of-terror: Grants fear immunity, a reaction forcing frightened creatures to flee, and expertise in Intimidation.
frhof_boon-of-the-bright-sun: Lets you radiate sunlight that dispels magical darkness and grants temporary hit points to you and allies each turn.
frhof_boon-of-the-furious-storm: Grants lightning and thunder resistance, immunity while Bloodied, and makes enemies worse at saving against your storm spells.
frhof_boon-of-the-soul-drinker: Grants cold and necrotic resistance and lets you heal a large amount when a nearby enemy drops.
frhof_chondathan-freebooter: A rough-and-tumble adventurer from Chondath's seas and cities who learned to survive by seizing opportunities.
frhof_cold-caster: Teaches Ray of Frost and lets your cold damage lower a target's next saving throw.
frhof_cult-of-the-dragon-initiate: Teaches Draconic, lets you frighten a nearby creature with a magic action, and can earn you Heroic Inspiration.
frhof_dead-magic-dweller: A survivor of a region where magic fails, who learned practical healing and endurance without arcane help.
frhof_dragon-cultist: A former follower of a cult that worships dragons, trained in secrecy and zealous service.
frhof_dragonscarred: Grants resistance to a chosen elemental damage type and lets you use dragon's terror as a bonus action after attacking or casting.
frhof_emerald-enclave-caretaker: A guardian of the wild who tended nature and wanderers on behalf of a conservationist faction.
frhof_emerald-enclave-fledgling: Gives you Speak with Animals with long ritual duration and lets you swap places with an ally while helping them.
frhof_enclave-magic: Gives advantage when influencing beasts and a free, concentration-free Beast Sense casting once per long rest.
frhof_fairy-trickster: Lets you ignore difficult terrain after disengaging and fluster creatures you hit so they save poorly.
frhof_flaming-fist-mercenary: A hardened soldier-for-hire of Baldur's Gate's mercenary company, used to tough fighting and rough discipline.
frhof_genie-magic: Once per long rest, lets you cast a level 1 sorcerer spell as a magic action, improving at higher levels.
frhof_genie-touched: A person marked by a genie's influence, whether through ancestry, a deal or an encounter with elemental magic.
frhof_harper: A secret agent of a network that fights tyranny and shares information, trained in subtlety and charm.
frhof_harper-agent: Teaches Thieves' Cant, grants a musical instrument proficiency, and lets you distract enemies from farther away when helping an ally attack.
frhof_harper-teamwork: Makes enemies you help your allies against worse at saving, and lets you end fear or paralysis on a nearby ally.
frhof_ice-fisher: A hardy northerner who fished through frozen waters and learned patience, endurance and alertness in bitter cold.
frhof_knight-of-the-gauntlet: A trained warrior in a holy order devoted to justice and healing, still early in a knightly career.
frhof_lordly-resolve: Lets you stand up several allies at once and shield them from charm, fear, and possession for a minute.
frhof_lords-alliance-agent: Critical hits can grant an ally Heroic Inspiration, and you gain advantage against enemies that hurt your nearby allies.
frhof_lords-alliance-vassal: A loyal servant of a political alliance of city rulers, trained in diplomacy and the art of leverage.
frhof_moonwell-pilgrim: A traveler who journeyed to a sacred moonlit spring, returning with a connection to druidic magic and nature.
frhof_mulhorandi-tomb-raider: A treasure seeker who explores the old tombs of Mulhorand, relying on cunning, knowledge of ancient rites and fortune.
frhof_mythal-touched: Lets you use a reaction when targeted by a spell to trigger a random magical effect from a table.
frhof_mythalkeeper: A caretaker of a city's magical protective field, trained to maintain its enchantments and craft useful items.
frhof_orders-resilience: Lets you stand up cheaply and gives you and a nearby ally advantage on Strength saving throws.
frhof_purple-dragon-commandant: Lets you grant allies temporary hit points as a bonus action and gives you advantage on attacks while Bloodied.
frhof_purple-dragon-rook: Grants a skill proficiency and lets you give nearby allies Heroic Inspiration when you roll initiative.
frhof_purple-dragon-squire: A young soldier in a kingdom's knightly order, learning leadership and loyalty to the crown.
frhof_rashemi-wanderer: A tough traveler from the harsh witch-led land of Rashemen, shaped by cold winters and hardy folk.
frhof_shadowmasters-exile: An outcast who fled a land of shadow magic, carrying skill with stealthy violence and a hard past.
frhof_spellfire-adept: Lets you spend Hit Dice to boost radiant spell damage and makes your radiant damage ignore resistance.
frhof_spellfire-initiate: A person touched by rare, fiery magical energy, who has begun learning to channel it.
frhof_spellfire-spark: Reduces damage taken from spells and magical effects and teaches Sacred Flame, castable as a bonus action a few times per day.
frhof_street-justice: Gives allies advantage against creatures you grapple, makes your bindings harder to escape, and removes intimidation penalties against hostile creatures.
frhof_tyro-of-the-gauntlet: Lets you use a reaction to stop an ally being pushed or pulled, and makes you harder to hit after readying.
frhof_zhentarim-mercenary: A hired blade tied to a shadowy mercantile network, used to rough work and bargains.
frhof_zhentarim-ruffian: Lets you roll opportunity attack damage twice and spend Heroic Inspiration to give your group advantage on initiative.
frhof_zhentarim-tactics: Lets you counterattack with an opportunity attack after being hit in melee, and grants temporary expertise in a skill each long rest.
ftd_dragonborn-chromatic: Dragonborn of chromatic ancestry with a breath weapon, damage resistance, and a fear-inducing burst of draconic magic.
ftd_dragonborn-gem: Dragonborn of gem ancestry with a breath weapon, resistance, psionic abilities, and brief flight.
ftd_dragonborn-metallic: Dragonborn of metallic ancestry with a breath weapon, resistance, and a second breath that debilitates enemies.
ftd_gift-of-the-chromatic-dragon: Lets you infuse a weapon with extra elemental damage and use a reaction to resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage.
ftd_gift-of-the-gem-dragon: Lets you use a reaction when damaged by a nearby creature to blast it with force damage and push it away.
ftd_gift-of-the-metallic-dragon: Grants a free cure wounds casting and a reaction that adds your proficiency bonus to someone's AC against one attack.
ggr_azorius-functionary: A bureaucrat of Ravnica's law-keeping guild who knows how to push paperwork and authority to their advantage.
ggr_boros-legionnaire: A soldier of Ravnica's militant guild of order and justice, used to rallying alongside its troops.
ggr_centaur: Fey equine folk with fast speed, a charging hoof strike, a sturdy build, and a knack for survival.
ggr_dimir-operative: A spy of Ravnica's secretive guild who works in shadows, using disguises and information to their advantage.
ggr_goblin: Ravnican goblins using standard goblin traits within the city's guild culture.
ggr_golgari-agent: A servant of Ravnica's guild of death and decay who works in the undercity among fungi and rot.
ggr_gruul-anarch: A wild member of Ravnica's rebellious clans who lives for raw freedom and the destruction of civilized order.
ggr_izzet-engineer: A volatile inventor in Ravnica's guild of experiment and lightning, always tinkering with dangerous devices.
ggr_loxodon: Elephant-like folk with natural armor, a trunk that grips objects, an acute sense of smell, and great endurance.
ggr_minotaur: Horned warriors with a goring rush, a hammering blow, and a tracking sense for enemies.
ggr_orzhov-representative: An emissary of Ravnica's guild of wealth and faith, able to command help from those below.
ggr_rakdos-cultist: A performer and thrill-seeker in Ravnica's cult of carnival chaos, devoted to spectacle and revelry.
ggr_selesnya-initiate: A devoted member of Ravnica's guild of nature and community, finding comfort and aid among its congregation.
ggr_simic-hybrid: Experimental hybrids with darkvision who grow extra animal adaptations such as gills, wings, or grappling tentacles.
ggr_simic-scientist: A researcher from Ravnica's guild of biology and adaptation, experienced in laboratory work and living experiments.
ggr_vedalken: Blue-skinned thinkers with mental-save advantage, tool and skill expertise, and a calm, precise mind.
gos_fisher: A coastal worker who earned a living on boats and in nets, with knowledge of the sea and its seasons.
gos_marine: A naval fighter who served on ships and in ports, comfortable with both sea and land operations.
gos_shipwright: A boat builder with a keen eye for hulls and rigging, who has contacts in the maritime trades.
gos_smuggler: A seagoing contraband runner who knows how to move forbidden goods and keeps allies along the coast.
mot_athlete: A competitor trained in contests of strength and agility, known and welcomed in the arenas of Theros.
mot_centaur: Theros centaurs using standard centaur traits, with a different cultural background.
mot_leonin: Lion folk with darkvision, claws for unarmed strikes, a roar that frightens foes, and Athletics proficiency.
mot_minotaur: Theros minotaurs using standard Ravnican minotaur traits, with a different cultural background.
mot_satyr: Fey revelers with magic resistance, a headbutt, a knack for music, and strong lasting vitality.
mot_triton: Theros tritons using the standard triton traits, with a different cultural outlook.
mpmm_aarakocra: Bird folk with a flying speed (unarmored), taloned unarmed strikes, and a wind-themed spell.
mpmm_aasimar: Celestial-touched people with darkvision, necrotic and radiant resistance, a healing touch, and a transformation at higher levels.
mpmm_bugbear: Long-limbed goblinoids with extended reach, charm resistance, stealth skill, a sneak-attack damage burst, and darkvision.
mpmm_centaur: Fey half-horse folk with fast movement, a charging hoof strike, strong carrying capacity, and a natural survival knack.
mpmm_changeling: Fey shapechangers who alter their looks at will and gain two social skill proficiencies.
mpmm_deep-gnome: Underdark gnomes with long-range darkvision, good stealth, and a few innate spells that become available at higher levels.
mpmm_duergar: Underdark dwarves with long-range darkvision, advantage against illusion and charm, and innate enlarging and invisibility magic.
mpmm_eladrin: Fey elves who pick a season for a short teleport with a seasonal side effect, plus darkvision and charm resistance.
mpmm_fairy: Tiny winged fey with innate flight and nature spells like faerie fire and enlarge/reduce.
mpmm_firbolg: Gentle giants with detection and disguise magic, a powerful nudge to push enemies, and talks with beasts and plants.
mpmm_genasi: Elemental-touched folk with darkvision, resistance tied to their element, and elemental magic depending on their heritage.
mpmm_genasi-air: Air genasi who can hold breath indefinitely, resist lightning, and cast shocking grasp, feather fall, and levitate.
mpmm_genasi-earth: Earth genasi who ignore difficult terrain on the ground and cast blade ward, pass without trace, and similar spells.
mpmm_genasi-fire: Fire genasi who resist fire and cast produce flame, burning hands, and flame blade.
mpmm_genasi-water: Water genasi who resist acid, breathe water, swim, and cast acid splash, create or destroy water, and similar magic.
mpmm_githyanki: Astral warriors who learn new skills and gear proficiencies daily and cast jump, misty step, and mage hand.
mpmm_githzerai: Disciplined psionic monks with a mental ward and invisible mage hand, shield, and detect thoughts.
mpmm_goblin: Small goblinoids who disengage or hide with a bonus action and deal extra damage against larger foes.
mpmm_goliath: Mountain giants' descendants with resistance to cold, strong lifting ability, and ancestry-based boons to attack or defend.
mpmm_harengon: Rabbit folk who add proficiency to initiative, hop away from danger, and dodge traps with a lucky reroll.
mpmm_hobgoblin: Disciplined goblinoids with darkvision, charm resistance, and a damage boost that helps allies near them.
mpmm_kenku: Corvid mimics with a gift for forgery, a knack for stealth and many skills, and an ability to imitate sounds.
mpmm_kobold: Small dragon-kin with darkvision, a frightening cry that grants advantage to allies, and pack tactics.
mpmm_lizardfolk: Reptilian folk with a swim speed, a fanged bite, natural armor, a long breath hold, and a hungry bite that heals.
mpmm_minotaur: Horned warriors who gore with unarmed strikes, rush into foes after dashing, and hammer enemies off their feet.
mpmm_orc: Fierce warriors with darkvision, a bonus-action dash that grants temporary hit points, and relentless endurance.
mpmm_satyr: Fey revelers with strong magic resistance, a headbutting charge, a knack for performance, and fey agility.
mpmm_sea-elf: Aquatic elves who breathe water, swim, speak with sea creatures, and keep elf trance and charm resistance.
mpmm_shadar-kai: Elves of the Shadowfell with a bonus-action teleport, necrotic resistance, and a trance-like rest.
mpmm_shifter: Beast-touched people with darkvision and a shifting ability that grants temporary hit points and a lineage benefit.
mpmm_tabaxi: Catlike wanderers with climbing speed, claws, darkvision, a burst of feline speed, and skills in stealth and perception.
mpmm_tortle: Turtle folk with a natural armor shell, claws, a defensive shell retreat, and a long breath hold.
mpmm_triton: Sea guardians who breathe water, swim, resist cold, speak with sea life, and cast fog cloud and wind magic.
mpmm_yuan-ti: Serpentine folk with darkvision, immunity to poison, advantage on saves against magic, and snake-speech.
mtf_dwarf-duergar: Gray dwarves with superior darkvision, illusion and charm resistance, and innate enlarge and invisibility magic.
mtf_elf-eladrin: Fey elf variant with a bonus-action teleport that carries a seasonal side effect.
mtf_elf-sea: Aquatic elves with a swim speed, water breathing, spear and net training, and the ability to talk to sea creatures.
mtf_elf-shadar-kai: Shadowfell elves with necrotic resistance and a bonus-action teleport once per rest.
mtf_gith: Tall, lean planar wanderers whose shared traits come from their githyanki or githzerai subrace.
mtf_gith-githyanki: Astral raiders with extra language and armor, weapon or tool training, plus psionic jump, misty step, and mage hand.
mtf_gith-githzerai: Monastic psychics with advantage against charm and fright, a psionic defense, and shield and detect thoughts magic.
mtf_gnome-deep: Underdark gnomes with superior darkvision, stone-based stealth, and bonuses to Dexterity and Strength.
mtf_svirfneblin-magic: Grants innate spellcasting: nondetection at will, plus blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self once each per long rest.
mtf_tiefling-asmodeus: Tiefling lineage with thaumaturgy, hellish rebuke, and darkness magic, plus fire resistance and darkvision.
mtf_tiefling-baalzebul: Tiefling lineage with thaumaturgy, ray of sickness, and crown of madness magic.
mtf_tiefling-dispater: Tiefling lineage with thaumaturgy, disguise self, and detect thoughts magic.
mtf_tiefling-fierna: Tiefling lineage with friends, charm person, and suggestion magic.
mtf_tiefling-glasya: Tiefling lineage with minor illusion, disguise self, and invisibility magic.
mtf_tiefling-levistus: Tiefling lineage with ray of frost, armor of Agathys, and darkness magic.
mtf_tiefling-mammon: Tiefling lineage with mage hand, floating disk, and arcane lock magic.
mtf_tiefling-mephistopheles: Tiefling lineage with mage hand, burning hands, and flame blade magic.
mtf_tiefling-zariel: Tiefling lineage with thaumaturgy, searing smite, and branding smite magic.
phb_acolyte: A former temple servant who can find shelter and support among fellow believers.
phb_actor: Gives advantage on Deception and Performance checks to impersonate someone, and lets you imitate voices and sounds you have heard.
phb_alert: Greatly boosts your initiative, prevents you from being surprised, and stops unseen attackers from gaining advantage against you.
phb_athlete: Makes standing up and climbing cheaper in movement and lets you make running jumps after a very short run.
phb_charger: After dashing, a bonus action lets you attack or shove, with bonus damage or extra push distance if you charged first.
phb_charlatan: A smooth-talking swindler who keeps a false identity ready and knows how to run a con.
phb_criminal: A career lawbreaker with a dependable underworld contact who can carry messages and favors.
phb_crossbow-expert: Removes crossbow loading limits and close-range penalties, and lets you fire a hand crossbow as a bonus action.
phb_custom-background: A flexible, build-your-own past that lets a player assemble a personal history from varied elements.
phb_defensive-duelist: Lets you use a reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against a melee hit while wielding a finesse weapon.
phb_dragonborn: Draconic folk with a chosen ancestry that sets a breath weapon and a matching damage resistance.
phb_dual-wielder: Gives a small AC bonus when wielding two weapons, allows non-light weapons for two-weapon fighting, and speeds up drawing weapons.
phb_dungeon-delver: Improves finding secret doors, avoiding traps, resisting trap damage, and keeping alert while traveling quickly.
phb_durable: Raises the minimum healing you get from rolling Hit Dice based on your Constitution modifier.
phb_dwarf: Stout folk with darkvision, poison resilience, combat training with axes and hammers, and a knack for stonework.
phb_dwarf-hill: Dwarf subrace with keen intuition and extra hit points that grow with each level.
phb_dwarf-mountain: Dwarf subrace trained in light and medium armor.
phb_elemental-adept: Lets your spells of one chosen element ignore resistance and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s; can be taken repeatedly.
phb_elf: Graceful folk with darkvision, keen senses, charm resistance, and a trance instead of sleep.
phb_elf-drow: Underdark elf subrace with superior darkvision, sunlight sensitivity, innate spells, and drow weapon training.
phb_elf-high: Elf subrace with a free wizard cantrip, an extra language, and training with swords and bows.
phb_elf-wood: Elf subrace with faster speed, concealment in light foliage, and training with swords and bows.
phb_entertainer: A performer who can always earn lodging and a meal by playing to an appreciative audience.
phb_folk-hero: A commoner who rose up against a local threat and is welcomed and sheltered by ordinary people.
phb_gnome: Small tinkerers with darkvision and advantage on mental saving throws against magic.
phb_gnome-forest: Gnome subrace with an innate illusion cantrip and the ability to talk with small animals.
phb_gnome-rock: Gnome subrace with lore bonuses about magic items and devices, and the skill to build tiny clockwork gadgets.
phb_grappler: Gives advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and lets you pin them, restraining both of you.
phb_great-weapon-master: Grants a bonus attack after crits or kills with melee weapons, and trades accuracy for big extra damage with heavy weapons.
phb_guild-artisan: A craftsperson belonging to a trade guild, whose membership brings lodging, support and political influence.
phb_half-elf: Folk of mixed heritage with darkvision, charm resistance, and two extra skill proficiencies.
phb_half-orc: Hardy fighters with darkvision, menacing presence, survival at zero hit points, and extra damage on critical hits.
phb_halfling: Small folk who can reroll natural 1s, resist fear, and slip past larger creatures.
phb_halfling-lightfoot: Halfling subrace that can hide behind larger creatures.
phb_halfling-stout: Halfling subrace with resistance to poison and advantage on saves against it.
phb_healer: Improves healer's kit use, restoring a hit point when stabilizing and letting you heal a creature once per rest.
phb_heavily-armored: Grants proficiency with heavy armor, letting you wear the heaviest protection available.
phb_heavy-armor-master: Reduces nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take while wearing heavy armor.
phb_hermit: A recluse who lived in seclusion for years and emerged with a quiet, valuable discovery.
phb_human: Versatile folk with a bonus to every ability score and an extra language.
phb_human-variant: Human variant trading the flat ability boost for two increases, one extra skill, and a starting feat.
phb_inspiring-leader: After a short speech, grants temporary hit points to up to six allies, once per creature per rest.
phb_keen-mind: Gives you a perfect sense of direction and time of day, and lets you recall anything from the past month.
phb_lightly-armored: Grants proficiency with light armor, letting you wear it without penalty.
phb_linguist: Teaches you three languages and lets you create written ciphers that others struggle to decode.
phb_lucky: Gives you a small pool of luck points to reroll attacks, checks, or saves, or to force a reroll against you.
phb_mage-slayer: Lets you attack spellcasters who cast nearby, makes them worse at keeping concentration, and gives you advantage on saves against their spells.
phb_magic-initiate: Teaches two cantrips and one level 1 spell from a chosen class list, with the spell castable once per long rest.
phb_martial-adept: Teaches two combat maneuvers and gives you a single superiority die to fuel them, refreshed on short or long rests.
phb_medium-armor-master: Removes the stealth penalty from medium armor and lets high Dexterity add more to your armor class.
phb_mobile: Increases your speed, lets dashing ignore difficult terrain, and prevents opportunity attacks from creatures you have attacked.
phb_moderately-armored: Grants proficiency with medium armor and shields, letting you wear and carry them without penalty.
phb_mounted-combatant: Improves fighting from a mount with advantage against smaller foes, the ability to redirect attacks, and better protection for your mount.
phb_noble: An aristocrat who enjoys status, deference from commoners and the comforts of family standing.
phb_observant: Lets you read lips and adds a large bonus to your passive Perception and Investigation.
phb_outlander: A wilderness native who navigates the wilds and can reliably find food and water for a group.
phb_polearm-master: Grants a bonus-action butt-end attack with reach weapons and lets you make opportunity attacks when enemies enter your reach.
phb_resilient: Grants proficiency in saving throws for one chosen ability score of your choice.
phb_ritual-caster: Gives you a ritual book with two level 1 ritual spells that you can grow by copying more rituals.
phb_sage: A scholar who spent years in study and knows where to track down answers to obscure questions.
phb_sailor: A ship's hand whose old crewmates and contacts can get you and your companions onto a vessel without paying fare.
phb_savage-attacker: Once per turn, lets you reroll a melee weapon attack's damage dice and keep whichever total you prefer.
phb_sentinel: Stops enemies you hit with opportunity attacks, ignores Disengage, and lets you strike creatures that attack your allies.
phb_sharpshooter: Removes long-range and cover penalties for ranged attacks and lets you trade accuracy for large extra damage.
phb_shield-master: Lets you shove foes with your shield as a bonus action and add its AC to Dexterity saves, even negating area damage.
phb_skilled: Grants proficiency in any three skills or tools you pick.
phb_skulker: Makes hiding easier in light cover, keeps you concealed after missed ranged attacks, and removes the dim-light sight penalty.
phb_soldier: A veteran of military service who still commands a measure of respect from other soldiers.
phb_spell-sniper: Doubles the range of attack-roll spells, ignores partial cover, and teaches you one extra attack cantrip.
phb_tavern-brawler: Makes you proficient with improvised weapons, boosts unarmed strikes to a d4, and lets you grapple as a bonus action after hitting.
phb_tiefling: Infernal-blooded folk with darkvision, fire resistance, and innate spells such as thaumaturgy and hellish rebuke.
phb_tough: Raises your maximum hit points by two per character level, now and on every level gained later.
phb_urchin: A street kid who survived on wits alone and knows secret ways to dash across a city.
phb_variant-criminal-spy: A secret agent who pilfers information rather than coin, with an underworld contact to pass along messages.
phb_variant-entertainer-gladiator: An arena fighter who thrills crowds with combat, able to find lodging and fans wherever audiences gather.
phb_variant-guild-artisan-guild-merchant: A trader tied to a merchant guild, whose membership brings lodging, support and influence.
phb_variant-noble-knight: A noble who holds a knightly rank and is attended by loyal servants who offer help.
phb_variant-noble-retainers: A noble whose household servants are loyal and ready to lend a hand.
phb_variant-sailor-pirate: A sea raider who learned to fight and bluff on the waves, and is feared in ports.
phb_war-caster: Helps you cast in combat: better concentration saves, spellcasting with full hands, and a spell instead of an opportunity attack.
phb_weapon-master: Grants proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.
rhw_aberrant-anatomy: Gives you hour-long breath holding, expertise in Perception, and short blindsight, but a natural 1 may stun you.
rhw_dhampir: Vampire-blooded folk with darkvision, climbing speed, a draining bite, and an ability to sense living creatures.
rhw_echoing-soul: Grants two skill proficiencies, a swappable expertise, and an extra language, but a natural 1 may leave you incapacitated and slowed.
rhw_gathered-whispers: Gives Message and Augury, a reaction that adds proficiency to your AC, but a natural 1 may deafen you.
rhw_haunted-one: A person marked by a dark, terrible experience, tied to horror and a shadowy gift from the Mists.
rhw_hexblood: Fey-cursed folk with darkvision, a hair token for magical benefits, and hex-flavored spellcasting.
rhw_investigator: A sleuth who hunts down clues and truths in dark places, perhaps with a gift from the Mists.
rhw_living-shadow: Gives Mage Hand and extra melee reach a few times per rest, but a natural 1 may let your shadow seize control.
rhw_lupin: Werewolf-touched folk with darkvision, slashing unarmed strikes, and a bonus pounce after attacking.
rhw_mist-walker: Helps you cross between Ravenloft domains and teleport as a reaction, but staying put too long spoils your short rests.
rhw_mist-wanderer: A traveler who passed through the Mists of Ravenloft and carries a strange gift from the dread domain.
rhw_reborn: Folk who returned from death with advantage on death saves, no need to sleep, and quick long rests.
rhw_second-skin: Lets you cast Alter Self free once per long rest, but a chosen trigger can force a transformation or stun you.
rhw_sharp-eye: When you Search or Study, you can gain advantage on the check a number of times equal to proficiency per long rest.
rhw_spirit-medium: A person who speaks with the dead, drawing on spiritual sensitivity and a gift of dark powers.
rhw_survivor: Lets you reroll low initiative results and, once per long rest, add proficiency to a failed save against charm or fear.
rhw_symbiotic-being: Grants a skill, a language, and a Hit Die boost to failed saves, but a natural 1 risks charm.
rhw_touch-of-death: Teaches Chill Touch with necrotic damage that ignores resistance, but you suffer disadvantage on death saving throws.
rhw_watchers: Gives Beast Sense and Speak with Animals plus a d4 boost to Search checks, but natural 1s can cause crippling paranoia.
sato_agent-of-order: Lets you add force damage to a hit and restrain the target until your next turn, usable proficiency-bonus times per long rest.
sato_baleful-scion: Lets you add necrotic damage to a hit and heal yourself for that amount, usable proficiency-bonus times per long rest.
sato_cohort-of-chaos: Rolling a 1 or 20 on an attack or save triggers a random chaotic effect until your next turn ends.
sato_gate-warden: A native of a planar gate-town who learned to find help and lodging, steeped in otherworldly energy.
sato_outlands-envoy: Teaches Misty Step and Tongues, each castable once per long rest without a slot, and Tongues needs no components.
sato_planar-philosopher: A thinker who studies the nature of the planes, shaped by otherworldly ancestry and wide-ranging debate.
sato_planar-wanderer: Grants daily elemental resistance, a way to force portals open or shut, and a sense for nearby planar portals.
sato_righteous-heritor: Uses a reaction to reduce damage to you or a nearby creature by 1d10 plus proficiency, a few times per long rest.
sato_scion-of-the-outer-planes: Ties you to an Outer Plane type, granting a matching damage resistance and a cantrip that you cast without material components.
scag_city-watch: A former city guard who knows the local streets and enjoys the trust of fellow officers.
scag_clan-crafter: A dwarf-style artisan raised in a craft-focused clan, with ties of kinship that bring aid and welcome.
scag_cloistered-scholar: A researcher who spent years in a great library, with access to its records and learned staff.
scag_courtier: A court insider who knows how nobles and officials operate, and can navigate their bureaucracy.
scag_faction-agent: A secret representative of a powerful faction who can call on allies and safe houses within it.
scag_far-traveler: A visitor from a distant land who stands out as exotic, drawing curiosity and sometimes opportunity.
scag_gnome-deep-svirfneblin: Underdark gnomes with superior darkvision, stone camouflage, and a knack for avoiding detection.
scag_half-elf-variant-aquatic-elf-descen: Half-elf variant gaining a swim speed in place of the standard extra skill proficiencies.
scag_half-elf-variant-drow-descent: Half-elf variant with dancing lights and faerie fire magic in place of the extra skills.
scag_half-elf-variant-moon-elf-or-sun-el: Half-elf variant with a wizard cantrip and elven weapon training.
scag_half-elf-variant-wood-elf-descent: Half-elf variant with faster walking speed, elven weapon training, and concealment in light foliage.
scag_halfling-ghostwise: Halfling subrace that communicates telepathically over a short distance and moves quietly.
scag_inheritor: Someone who received a treasured heirloom, such as a family relic, that shapes their destiny.
scag_knight-of-the-order: A member of a knightly order dedicated to a cause, with allies in the order and deference from peers.
scag_mercenary-veteran: A soldier-for-hire experienced in many contracts, who knows the market for fighting folk.
scag_tiefling-variant-devils-tongue: Tiefling variant with vicious mockery, charm person, and enthrall in place of standard infernal magic.
scag_tiefling-variant-hellfire: Tiefling variant with burning hands, darkness, and similar fire magic in place of standard infernal magic.
scag_tiefling-variant-infernal-legacy: Tiefling variant with a different set of spells and an alternate appearance.
scag_tiefling-variant-winged: Tiefling variant that gains flight in exchange for the usual infernal spellcasting.
scag_urban-bounty-hunter: A tracker of fugitives in city streets, with a network of contacts and informants for hire.
scag_uthgardt-tribe-member: A barbarian raised in a northern tribe with ancient traditions, familiar with the land and its lore.
scag_variant-city-watch-investigator: A city officer who solved crimes rather than patrolling, familiar with local streets and fellow officers.
scag_waterdhavian-noble: A noble raised in Waterdeep's high society, enjoying privilege, wealth and entry to elite circles.
scc_lorehold-student: A student of the Strixhaven college devoted to history and the spirits of the past.
scc_owlin: Owl folk with long-range darkvision, silent flight, and stealth bonuses.
scc_prismari-student: A student of the Strixhaven college devoted to artistic expression and elemental magic.
scc_quandrix-student: A student of the Strixhaven college devoted to mathematics and the patterns of nature.
scc_silverquill-student: A student of the Strixhaven college devoted to eloquence, writing and persuasive speech.
scc_strixhaven-initiate: Teaches two cantrips and one first-level spell from your chosen Strixhaven college, with the spell castable free once per long rest.
scc_strixhaven-mascot: Lets you cast Find Familiar as a ritual in mascot form, trade an attack for its attack, and swap places with it.
scc_witherbloom-student: A student of the Strixhaven college devoted to life, decay and herb-craft.
tce_artificer-initiate: Teaches one artificer cantrip and a first-level spell, castable free once daily, plus artisan tool proficiency usable as a spell focus.
tce_chef: Grants cook's utensils proficiency, extra healing from meals during short rests, and bonus temporary hit point treats.
tce_crusher: Lets bludgeoning hits shove a target 5 feet, and bludgeoning critical hits give attackers advantage against that creature.
tce_custom-lineage: Flexible origin that lets you build a heritage with a feat, a chosen ability boost, and darkvision or a skill.
tce_eldritch-adept: Teaches you one warlock eldritch invocation that you can swap whenever you gain a level.
tce_fey-touched: Teaches Misty Step plus one first-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable free once per long rest.
tce_fighting-initiate: Teaches you one fighter fighting style, which you can swap for another when you gain an ability score improvement level.
tce_gunner: Grants firearm proficiency, ignores firearm loading limits, and removes the penalty for shooting at adjacent enemies.
tce_metamagic-adept: Teaches two sorcerer metamagic options and gives you 2 sorcery points for them, refreshed on long rests.
tce_piercer: Lets you reroll one piercing damage die once per turn and adds an extra die on piercing critical hits.
tce_poisoner: Makes your poison damage ignore resistance, speeds up poison application, and lets you brew potent doses that poison foes.
tce_shadow-touched: Teaches Invisibility plus one first-level illusion or necromancy spell, each castable free once per long rest.
tce_skill-expert: Grants one new skill proficiency and doubles your proficiency bonus in one skill you already know.
tce_slasher: Slashing hits can slow a target by 10 feet, and slashing critical hits give it disadvantage on attacks.
tce_telekinetic: Teaches a stealthier Mage Hand and lets you shove a creature 5 feet with your mind as a bonus action.
tce_telepathic: Lets you speak telepathically with nearby creatures and cast Detect Thoughts once per long rest without a slot.
toa_anthropologist: A student of other cultures who learned the languages and customs of far-off peoples.
toa_archaeologist: A dedicated digger of ancient sites who studies relics and old civilizations, welcomed by scholars.
vgm_aasimar: Celestial-touched folk with darkvision, necrotic and radiant resistance, a light cantrip, and a healing touch.
vgm_aasimar-fallen: Aasimar subrace that can transform to frighten nearby foes and deal extra necrotic damage.
vgm_aasimar-protector: Aasimar subrace that sprouts radiant wings to fly and deal extra radiant damage briefly.
vgm_aasimar-scourge: Aasimar subrace that radiates harmful light to deal extra radiant damage, hurting nearby creatures and themself.
vgm_bugbear: Long-limbed goblinoids with extended reach, stealth skill, a surprise-attack damage burst, and darkvision.
vgm_firbolg: Gentle giants with disguise and detect magic, a powerful nudge, plus speech with plants and beasts.
vgm_goblin: Small goblinoids who disengage or hide as a bonus action and deal extra damage to larger creatures.
vgm_goliath: Mountain giants' descendants with Athletics skill, resistance to cold, a once-per-rest damage shrug, and strong carrying ability.
vgm_hobgoblin: Disciplined warriors with darkvision, extra damage when near allies, and a gift for saving face when failing.
vgm_kenku: Corvid forgers with expert duplication of handwriting, sound mimicry, and several skill choices.
vgm_kobold: Small dragon-kin with darkvision, pack tactics, and a weakness in bright sunlight.
vgm_lizardfolk: Reptilian folk with a swim speed, natural armor, a hungry bite, a long breath hold, and survival skills.
vgm_orc: Fierce warriors with darkvision, bonus-action rushes toward enemies, and strong intimidation.
vgm_tabaxi: Catlike wanderers with climbing speed, claws, darkvision, a burst of feline speed, and sneaky skills.
vgm_triton: Sea guardians who breathe water, swim, resist cold, speak with sea life, and cast fog cloud and wind magic.
vgm_yuan-ti-pureblood: Serpentine folk with darkvision, advantage against magic, poison immunity, and the ability to speak with snakes.
vrgr_dhampir: Vampire-blooded lineage with darkvision, spider climbing, a draining bite, and the ability to sense living creatures.
vrgr_haunted-one: A person scarred by a horrifying encounter, hunted by the memory or presence of something terrible.
vrgr_hexblood: Fey-cursed lineage with darkvision, a hair token for magical benefits, and a hex-flavored spell set.
vrgr_investigator: A detective who pursues clues and mysteries, skilled at finding leads and the truth behind crimes.
vrgr_reborn: Lineage of those returned from death, with deathless resilience, no need to sleep, and resistance to disease.
wbtw_fairy: Tiny winged fey with innate flight and nature spells like faerie fire and enlarge/reduce.
wbtw_feylost: A person who spent time lost in the Feywild, surviving by wit and a fey-touched sense of strangeness.
wbtw_harengon: Rabbit folk who add proficiency to initiative, hop away from danger, and dodge traps with a lucky reroll.
wbtw_witchlight-hand: A worker at a traveling fey carnival who performs and does odd jobs, with friends among its troupe.
wow_arathi-heritage: Gives advantage on saves against charm and a rare chance to turn a failed save against unconsciousness into a success.
wow_child-of-the-sea: Lets you hold your breath for several minutes and grants a swim speed equal to your Speed.
wow_clearcasting: A critical spell attack lets you cast an action cantrip as a reaction, and force spells treat 1s as 2s.
wow_dracthyr: Dragon-bloodlines with darkvision, gliding wings that soften falls, a breath attack, and a draconic visage form.
wow_draenei: Crystal-touched exiles with darkvision, a lineage of Light or fel magic, and a few innate spells.
wow_dwarf: Azerothian dwarves that follow the standard dwarf traits with small changes.
wow_earthen: Stone-bodied folk with an azerite surge that heals allies and harms enemies, plus sturdy earthen resilience.
wow_elf: Azerothian elves with darkvision, charm resistance, trance rest, and a choice of lineage that grants spells.
wow_elusive-brawler: Lets you use a reaction to take the Dodge action whenever you take damage.
wow_enveloping-mist: Healing you provide wraps the target in mist that can reduce one incoming hit or later become temporary hit points.
wow_fingers-of-frost: Your spells ignore cold resistance and deal extra cold damage to restrained creatures.
wow_fists-of-fury: Improves unarmed and light weapon damage dice and adds escalating damage to unarmed hits on a creature you already struck that turn.
wow_forsaken: Undead survivors with darkvision, necrotic resistance, no need to sleep, and resilience against some hardships.
wow_gnome: Azerothian gnomes with the standard gnome traits and tinkering lineage spells.
wow_goblin: Small, scrappy folk with darkvision, charm resistance, and a bite against bigger creatures.
wow_haranir: World-tree-bonded folk with long-range darkvision, Nature and Survival skills, and druidic cantrips.
wow_hot-streak: Your spells ignore fire resistance, and fire damage sets targets burning, with repeated fire hits making the burn worse.
wow_human: Azerothian humans with the standard human traits, gaining an origin feat.
wow_inscription-adept: Teaches Illusory Script, castable free daily, and unlocks higher-level inscription spells as your proficiency grows.
wow_mechagnome: Mechanical gnomes with a d4 bonus to rolls a few times per rest, plus sturdy construct resilience.
wow_orc: Azerothian orcs that follow the standard orc traits with small changes.
wow_pandaren: Bear-like folk with darkvision, fall resistance, a calming bonus to short-rest healing, and a knack for cooking.
wow_stagger-and-sway: Lets you reduce damage by your Dexterity modifier now and take it later as force damage, with Wisdom clearing the backlog.
wow_tauren: Bovine warriors with piercing horn strikes, a charge-and-gore rush, and strong carrying capacity.
wow_troll: Tusked trolls who gain advantage on attacks while bloodied, darkvision, and boosted short-rest healing.
wow_void-warrior: Teaches you two warlock cantrips that count as ranger spells using Wisdom, and you can swap them as you level.
wow_vulpera: Fox-like scavengers with darkvision, fire resistance, a knack for sniffing out danger, and damage reduction after initiative.
wow_will-to-survive: Lets you ignore being incapacitated on your turn at the price of one level of exhaustion.
wow_worgen: Werewolf-like folk who shift into a bestial form for temporary hit points and keen senses.
xge_bountiful-luck: Uses a reaction to let a nearby ally reroll a natural 1 on an attack, check, or save.
xge_dragon-fear: Spend your Breath Weapon use to roar and frighten creatures within 30 feet who fail a Wisdom save.
xge_dragon-hide: Gives unarmored AC of 13 plus Dexterity and retractable claws that deal d4 slashing unarmed damage.
xge_drow-high-magic: Lets you cast Detect Magic at will and Levitate and Dispel Magic once each per long rest, using Charisma.
xge_dwarven-fortitude: When you take the Dodge action, you can spend a Hit Die to heal yourself.
xge_elven-accuracy: When you have advantage on an attack roll that uses Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, you roll a third die.
xge_fade-away: Uses a reaction after taking damage to turn invisible briefly, recharging on a short or long rest.
xge_fey-teleportation: Teaches Sylvan and Misty Step, castable once per rest without a slot, using Intelligence.
xge_flames-of-phlegethos: Lets you reroll ones on fire spell damage and wreath yourself in flames that burn melee attackers.
xge_infernal-constitution: Grants resistance to cold and poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned.
xge_orcish-fury: Adds an extra weapon damage die once per rest and a free reaction attack after Relentless Endurance triggers.
xge_prodigy: Grants a skill, a tool proficiency, a language, and expertise in one skill you already know.
xge_second-chance: Uses a reaction to force an attacker to reroll a hit against you, recharging on initiative or rest.
xge_squat-nimbleness: Increases your walking speed by 5 feet, grants Acrobatics or Athletics proficiency, and helps you escape grapples.
xge_wood-elf-magic: Teaches a druid cantrip plus Longstrider and Pass without Trace, each castable once per long rest, using Wisdom.
xphb_aasimar: Celestial-touched folk with darkvision, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, a healing touch, and a radiant transformation.
xphb_ability-score-improvement: Raises one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1, capped at 20, and can be taken repeatedly.
xphb_acolyte: A temple helper who spent youth in religious service, gaining a knack for clerical magic.
xphb_actor: Gives advantage on checks to pass as a disguised person and lets you imitate voices and sounds, resistible with Insight.
xphb_alert: Adds your proficiency bonus to initiative and lets you trade initiative results with a willing ally.
xphb_archery: Gives a flat +2 bonus to attack rolls made with ranged weapons.
xphb_artisan: A skilled craftsperson who learned a trade through apprenticeship, with a talent for making useful things.
xphb_athlete: Grants a climbing speed, cheap standing up from prone, and long or high jumps after only a short run-up.
xphb_blessed-warrior: Teaches you two cleric cantrips that work as paladin spells using Charisma, and you can swap them as you level.
xphb_blind-fighting: Gives you blindsight out to 10 feet, so you sense nearby creatures without needing sight.
xphb_boon-of-combat-prowess: Once per turn cycle, turns one missed attack roll into a hit.
xphb_boon-of-dimensional-travel: After attacking or casting with an action, you may teleport up to 30 feet to a visible empty space.
xphb_boon-of-energy-resistance: Grants resistance to two chosen damage types that you can change daily, plus a reaction to redirect that damage at a foe.
xphb_boon-of-fate: Lets you add or subtract 2d4 on a nearby creature's d20 roll, recharging on initiative or rest.
xphb_boon-of-fortitude: Adds 40 to your maximum hit points and boosts healing you receive by your Constitution modifier once per turn.
xphb_boon-of-irresistible-offense: Your physical weapon damage bypasses resistance, and natural 20 attack rolls deal bonus damage equal to your boosted ability score.
xphb_boon-of-recovery: Once per long rest you drop to 1 hit point and heal half your maximum instead; also grants ten healing d10s.
xphb_boon-of-skill: Makes you proficient in every skill and grants expertise in one skill you lack expertise in.
xphb_boon-of-speed: Adds 30 feet to your Speed and lets you Disengage as a bonus action, which also frees you from grapples.
xphb_boon-of-spell-recall: When you cast with a slot of levels 1 to 4, a d4 roll may leave the slot unspent.
xphb_boon-of-the-night-spirit: In dim light or darkness you can turn invisible as a bonus action and resist all damage except psychic and radiant.
xphb_boon-of-truesight: Gives you truesight out to a range of 60 feet, letting you see through darkness and illusions.
xphb_charger: Makes Dash faster and lets a melee hit after a straight 10-foot run deal extra damage or push the target.
xphb_charlatan: A con artist who lived by deception and fast talk, picking up a range of practical talents.
xphb_chef: Grants cook's utensils proficiency, extra healing for allies during short rests, and bonus temporary hit point treats.
xphb_crafter: Grants three artisan tool proficiencies, 20 percent off nonmagical purchases, and a piece of gear crafted each long rest.
xphb_criminal: A lawbreaker who lived by stealth and quick hands, honing a constant wariness for trouble.
xphb_crossbow-expert: Lets you ignore crossbow loading, shoot in melee without penalty, and add your modifier to off-hand light crossbow damage.
xphb_crusher: Lets bludgeoning hits shove a target 5 feet, and critical hits give allies advantage against that creature.
xphb_defense: Gives a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear any armor.
xphb_defensive-duelist: While holding a finesse weapon, you can use a reaction to add proficiency to your AC against one melee hit.
xphb_dragonborn: Draconic folk with a chosen ancestry, an elemental breath weapon, matching resistance, and short flight at higher levels.
xphb_druidic-warrior: Teaches you two druid cantrips that count as ranger spells using Wisdom, and you can swap them as you level.
xphb_dual-wielder: Enables two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons, a bonus action off-hand attack, and drawing or stowing two weapons at once.
xphb_dueling: Adds +2 damage when you wield a single one-handed melee weapon and nothing in your other hand.
xphb_durable: Gives advantage on death saving throws and lets you spend a Hit Die as a bonus action to heal.
xphb_dwarf: Sturdy folk with long-range darkvision, poison resilience, extra hit points, and stonecunning tremorsense.
xphb_elemental-adept: Your spells of one chosen element ignore resistance and treat low damage dice as 2s; can be taken again for other elements.
xphb_elf: Graceful folk with darkvision, charm resistance, trance rest, and a chosen lineage granting spells and a bonus skill.
xphb_entertainer: A traveling performer who made a living delighting crowds, with a gift for music.
xphb_farmer: A rural worker who toiled on land and with animals, building endurance and toughness.
xphb_fey-touched: Teaches Misty Step plus one first-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable free once per long rest.
xphb_gnome: Small, clever folk with darkvision, advantage on mental saves, and a lineage granting illusions or tiny constructs.
xphb_goliath: Giant-descended folk with a chosen ancestry boon, a large form that grows stronger, and extra carrying power.
xphb_grappler: Lets one unarmed hit both damage and grapple, gives advantage against your grappled targets, and makes dragging them cheaper.
xphb_great-weapon-fighting: Lets you count low damage dice as 3s when swinging a two-handed or versatile melee weapon with both hands.
xphb_great-weapon-master: Heavy weapon hits add your proficiency bonus in damage, and critical hits or kills grant a bonus action attack.
xphb_guard: A watchman who stood vigil over walls or streets, keeping a sharp eye out for trouble.
xphb_guide: A trail leader who led travelers through wild country, picking up a touch of nature magic.
xphb_halfling: Small folk who reroll natural 1s, resist fear, slip past larger creatures, and hide behind them.
xphb_healer: Lets you use a healer's kit to heal a nearby creature with hit dice, and rerolls ones on healing dice.
xphb_heavily-armored: Grants you training with heavy armor so you can wear it without penalty.
xphb_heavy-armor-master: While in heavy armor, you reduce incoming bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by your proficiency bonus.
xphb_hermit: A recluse who lived apart from society, learning healing arts while searching for meaning.
xphb_human: Adaptable folk who gain inspiration after long rests, a free skill, and an origin feat.
xphb_inspiring-leader: After a rest, you rally up to six allies with a performance that grants them temporary hit points.
xphb_interception: Uses a reaction to cut damage dealt to a nearby ally by 1d10 plus proficiency, if you hold a shield or weapon.
xphb_keen-mind: Grants proficiency or expertise in a chosen knowledge skill and lets you take the Study action as a bonus action.
xphb_lightly-armored: Grants training with light armor and shields so you can use them without penalty.
xphb_lucky: Gives a pool of luck points to gain advantage on your d20 rolls or impose disadvantage on attacks against you.
xphb_mage-slayer: Makes casters you hurt more likely to lose concentration, and once per rest lets you pass a failed mental save.
xphb_magic-initiate: Teaches two cantrips and one first-level spell from the cleric, druid, or wizard list; the spell is castable free daily.
xphb_martial-weapon-training: Grants you proficiency with all martial weapons, expanding the weapons you can use well.
xphb_medium-armor-master: Medium armor lets you add up to +3 from Dexterity instead of +2 once your Dexterity reaches 16.
xphb_merchant: A trader who bought, sold and haggled across regions, with a knack for fortunate deals.
xphb_moderately-armored: Grants you training with medium armor so you can wear it without penalty.
xphb_mounted-combatant: While mounted, you gain advantage against smaller unmounted foes, your mount avoids area damage, and you can redirect hits meant for it.
xphb_musician: Grants three instrument proficiencies and lets you play a song after resting to give allies Heroic Inspiration.
xphb_noble: A person raised among wealth and privilege, educated and practiced in court manners and conversation.
xphb_observant: Grants proficiency or expertise in Insight, Investigation, or Perception and lets you Search as a bonus action.
xphb_orc: Hardy folk with darkvision, a bonus-action dash that grants temporary hit points, and endurance that avoids dropping.
xphb_piercer: Lets you reroll one piercing damage die once per turn and adds an extra die on piercing critical hits.
xphb_poisoner: Makes your poison damage ignore resistance and lets you brew potent poison doses that damage and poison foes.
xphb_polearm-master: Gives a bonus action butt-end attack with polearm-style weapons and a reaction attack on creatures entering your reach.
xphb_protection: Uses a reaction and your shield to impose disadvantage on attacks against a nearby ally.
xphb_resilient: Grants proficiency in saving throws for one chosen ability.
xphb_ritual-caster: Gives a set of always-prepared level 1 ritual spells and a once-per-day way to cast one quickly without a slot.
xphb_sage: A scholar who spent years in libraries and study, with a grounding in arcane magic.
xphb_sailor: A deckhand who lived aboard ships, tough from rowdy dockside scraps and rough seas.
xphb_savage-attacker: Once per turn, roll your weapon's damage dice twice after a hit and keep whichever result you prefer.
xphb_scribe: A copyist and record-keeper who worked with ink and documents, trained in careful, detailed skills.
xphb_sentinel: Lets you punish creatures near you who disengage or attack others, and a hit halts the target's movement.
xphb_shadow-touched: Teaches Invisibility plus one first-level illusion or necromancy spell, each castable free once per long rest.
xphb_sharpshooter: Ranged weapon attacks ignore most cover, suffer no melee-range penalty, and take no penalty at long range.
xphb_shield-master: Lets you shove or knock prone with your shield after a melee hit, and take no damage on successful Dexterity saves.
xphb_skill-expert: Grants one new skill proficiency and expertise in a skill you already know.
xphb_skilled: Grants proficiency in any three skills or tools, and can be taken more than once.
xphb_skulker: Gives 10-foot blindsight, advantage on hiding during combat, and keeps you hidden when your attacks miss.
xphb_slasher: Slashing hits can slow a target by 10 feet, and slashing critical hits give it disadvantage on its attacks.
xphb_soldier: A trained fighter from an army or militia, familiar with brutal combat and discipline.
xphb_speedy: Adds 10 feet to your Speed, ignores difficult terrain when dashing, and makes opportunity attacks against you less accurate.
xphb_spell-sniper: Your spell attacks ignore most cover, suffer no penalty in melee, and gain 60 extra feet of range.
xphb_tavern-brawler: Improves unarmed strikes with better damage and rerolled ones, grants improvised weapon proficiency, and lets you shove foes you hit.
xphb_telekinetic: Improves Mage Hand into a stealthier, longer-range spell and lets you shove a creature a short distance as a bonus action.
xphb_telepathic: Lets you speak mind-to-mind with nearby creatures and cast Detect Thoughts once per long rest without a slot.
xphb_thrown-weapon-fighting: Adds +2 damage to ranged hits made with thrown weapons.
xphb_tiefling: Infernal-heritage folk with darkvision and a chosen legacy of fiendish spells and resistance.
xphb_tough: Raises your hit point maximum by two per character level, including levels gained later.
xphb_two-weapon-fighting: Lets you add your ability modifier to the damage of your extra light-weapon attack.
xphb_unarmed-fighting: Makes unarmed strikes deal d6 or d8 bludgeoning damage and lets you hurt a creature you have grappled at turn start.
xphb_war-caster: Improves combat casting with advantage on concentration saves, spellcasting while holding gear, and casting a spell instead of an opportunity attack.
xphb_wayfarer: A drifter who grew up on the road, surviving by wits and a touch of good fortune.
xphb_weapon-master: Lets you use the mastery property of one weapon type you are proficient with, changeable after each long rest.
